name: Needing Him
overview: The Scriptures reveal our deep need for God’s provision and presence, inviting all who thirst to come freely and receive His grace without cost, as Isaiah 55:1 declares. This need is met through drawing near to God with repentance and sincerity, promising that He will respond and purify our hearts, as James 4:8 encourages. Furthermore, Romans 16:20 assures believers of the ultimate victory and peace granted by the Lord Jesus Christ, who empowers us to overcome spiritual adversaries, underscoring our continual dependence on His sustaining grace.
